name: instantprd-mcp
stderr:
instantprd-mcp: INSTANTPRD_TOKEN is not set — the instantprd-mcp server cannot talk to InstantPRD without it.

Set it when you register the server:

  claude mcp add instantprd -e INSTANTPRD_TOKEN=<your token> -- npx instantprd-mcp

Create a token in https://instantprd.web.id → Settings → Access tokens (account-scoped, or scoped to one plan).
Optional: -e INSTANTPRD_PLAN=<plan id> to work on one plan without passing `plan` to every tool,
and -e INSTANTPRD_API_URL=<url> when you run InstantPRD yourself.
